curated-gf-jaini-gf-noto-serif-gujarati: Jaini crowds its letters together like logs in a river boom, every stroke the same width. Noto Serif Gujarati, a classic serif, is the one built for reading, with oversized counters and joins that ease only slightly in weight.
curated-gf-jaini-purva-gf-changa: Tight, bold, and puzzle-piece snug. Jaini Purva keeps one thickness throughout while Changa, a sans with a lowercase as sturdy as cast iron capitals, gives the headline a broad, modern floor to stand on.
curated-gf-jersey-10-charted-gf-cambo: Cambo reads like a text serif with a short step up to its capitals and a gentle thick-and-thin rhythm (fine for a fishing lodge, say). Jersey 10 Charted adds tight, snug lettering on top.
curated-gf-jersey-10-charted-gf-noto-nas: Jersey 10 Charted sets tight, snugly spaced letters in bold display form. Noto Nastaliq Urdu below it has a dignified, editorial feel, with low ascenders and a mild stress in its rounds that keeps lines compact down a page.
curated-gf-jersey-15-charted-gf-noto-san: Noto Sans Hatran reads approachably, its e opening wide like a funnel, which suits a plain sans (a dinosaur book cover, perhaps). Jersey 15 Charted coils tightly above it.
curated-gf-jersey-15-charted-gf-yuji-bok: Distinctive and tightly wound, Jersey 15 Charted closes its curves almost shut. Yuji Boku, a serif, answers with strokes of one thickness and a bracelet-wide c, so a longer passage feels smooth and unhurried.
curated-gf-jersey-20-charted-fs-hind: Words shrink-wrapped around their letters, with a c whose mouth is only a slit, define Jersey 20 Charted. Hind, a sans-serif, sits beneath with steady strokes and round letters that stay open, giving the heading room to command.
curated-gf-jersey-25-charted-gf-momo-tru: Jersey 25 Charted packs its letters into a dense, tall-standing run with a barely open c. Momo Trust Display, a sans-serif with a generous x-height and drifting spacing, works best at a size noticeably smaller than the heading.
curated-gf-jockey-one-fs-merriweather-sa: Jockey One winds its letters tight like thread on a spool, ready for a tax form or two. Merriweather Sans, a sans with tall lowercase and an e that opens clearly, brings sturdy, easy size to the words.
curated-gf-jomolhari-gf-sawarabi-mincho: Fine hairline arms on stout stems give Jomolhari a dignified look, nice on a name tag perhaps. Sawarabi Mincho, a text serif with mid-level contrast, carries longer lines with a classic, refined hand.
